findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_weekend, get_decision_feed · Public sink: get_decision_feed, share_local_favorite, share_gem · Destructive: unsave_listing, unmark_going.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_weekend, get_decision_feed · Public sink: get_decision_feed, share_local_favorite, share_gem · Destructive: unsave_listing, unmark_going

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_neighborhoods" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Returns the complete and EXCLUSIVE list of 35 San Francisco Bay Area neighborhood centroids (San Francisco, Oakland, and Berkeley ONLY) with coordinates and radii. This is the whole serviceable market - no other city, region, or country is covered. Use it to (a) map a user query to an exact SF Bay A" → after: "35 San Francisco, Oakland, and Berkeley neighborhood centroids. Locations outside that area are out of market."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
